Class GeneratorParams

java.lang.Object
smile.onnx.genai.GeneratorParams
All Implemented Interfaces:
AutoCloseable
public final class GeneratorParams extends Object implements AutoCloseable
Search and sampling options for a Generator.

Common search option names include max_length, temperature, top_p, top_k, do_sample, and repetition_penalty.
